## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under LICENSE.txt.
- [x] Changed-file pre-commit hooks pass and formatting is committed.
- [x] Reviewed applicable AGENTS.md hard rules; support tracker updated (S2).
- [ ] Requested labels: `cat-feature`, `area:frost`, `area:global_attention`, `orig-external` (the external author cannot apply upstream labels).

## Affected area

FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL (SM120 SDPA forward).

## Summary

Enable FP16/BF16 dense exact-D128 additive attention bias on SM120. Load FP32 or matching-dtype bias directly into registers, broadcasting batch/head dimensions and applying `scale * QK + bias` before masking and softmax. Bind current caller storage through the shared prepared dense validator.

## Why

SM120 plans currently decline additive bias. A bias-only prepared host and natural-unit score scale provide the native lowering without execute-time copies or extra kernels. Stable max subtraction avoids inverse-scale and log2-intermediate overflow; the bias-present sink epilogue handles zero-mass `-inf` rows and `+inf` sinks. Rule S15 records these traps and detectors.

## Related issues

Related to #381.

## API and compatibility impact

Scope is unsplit, unpacked M64/M128 prefill with exact D_QK=D_V=128. Existing top-left causal, sliding-window, right-band and padding masks compose. Other heads, decode tiles, THD, paging, splits, PackGQA and execute-time shape/stride overrides retain declines. The graph contract already forbids bottom-right causal with bias; standalone preserves that restriction.

The optional standalone execute operand is appended. No graph API, heuristic or tolerance change. The bias-free host ABI, specialization and arithmetic remain intact. Execution adds no allocation, host read, layout conversion or runtime compilation. No performance claim. Native qualification is cc12.0 only.

## Testing

RTX 6000D (SM120), Python3.12, cuDNN9.27.0.42, Torch2.13+cu130, CuTeDSL4.8.0/CUDA13.4. Private source imports and all nine changed-file hashes verified.

```sh
# 55 passed
python -m pytest sdpa/frost/test_frost_sdpa_bias_sm120.py -k frost --collect-only -q
# 55 collected
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck --report-api-errors no --error-exitcode 99 python -m pytest sdpa/frost/test_frost_sdpa_bias_sm120.py -k 'frost and not physical_int64' --maxfail=1 -q
# 53 passed, 2 deselected; ERROR SUMMARY: 0 errors; runner exit 0
python -m pytest sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_prepared_sm120.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_native_sm120_binding.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_fp8_sm120.py -k 'frost and (rebind_strides_and_storage or capture_first_execute or graph_and_adapter_bind_the_same_frame or split_capture_rebind or thd_capture_rebind or actual_host_frames or bad_partial_contract or revalidates_current_storage or strided_stats or pack_gqa_tile64 or bottom_right_rectangular)' --maxfail=1 -q
# 81 passed, 394 deselected
```

Tests pin FROST and use FP64 references, graph/independent standalone execution, retained replay with changed inputs/storage, O/Stats canaries, invalid-operand rejection, and physical Int64 strides/products. The two 8–13 GiB physical cases poison wrapped addresses and pass in the ordinary matrix; they are excluded from memcheck. Tiny/negative/large scales, finite ±3e38 bias and infinite sink transitions have RED controls and passing regressions. Original tolerances are retained.

Sanitizer qualification covers device memory; independent framework API-probe diagnostics are excluded. Changed-file pre-commit, Python syntax and `git diff --check` pass. Independent spec/code review cleared the final sink endpoint fix.

Shared detector control on the same host/cc12.0 with Compute Sanitizer13.2.23: valid memory/race programs exit0; intentionally invalid memory and shared-memory race programs each exit99 with an actual diagnostic (one invalid global write / one reported race). ## CI/review follow-up: explicit host exports

Make the prepared hosts explicit module exports to address the CodeQL unused-import pattern. All three exported callables remain the identical prepared_host objects; no kernel/class/function AST or ABI changes. Fresh lazy-import/identity probes and five real SM120 bias/plain binding and capture controls pass (18.39s); changed-file pre-commit passes. CodeQL re-evaluation on the new head remains an upstream CI result.

## API-tail contract integration follow-up

Fixed the CI-reported stale signature expectation in 245cb47: SM120 explicitly retains sf_o followed by bias_tensor=None; existing sf_o checks and SM100 ordering remain. Entire API contract module: 14 passed; bias module: 55 collected. No production signature, kernel or tolerance change. Fresh FROST CI requested for 245cb47.

@@ -601,6 +601,23 @@ and live/empty transitions; a sanitizer pass or a single launch does not
 establish liveness.
 
 
+**Rule S15 — Keep additive logits in range before softmax.**
+
+A representable attention scale and finite bias must not overflow merely from
+an algebraic rewrite. Folding `bias / scale` into unscaled QK overflows at
+`scale = 1e-38` with ordinary finite bias; pre-converting a large scale or row
+max to base 2 can also overflow while the natural-unit logits are finite.
+Form `scale * QK + bias` in natural units, subtract the row max before base-2
+conversion, and retain that natural-unit max for LSE (or explicitly bound and
+decline an unsafe numerical domain). Preserve the bias-free specialization.
+An all-`-inf` attention row with an `-inf` sink has zero mass (O = 0,
+LSE = -inf); a `+inf` sink dominates finite attention logits (O = 0,
+LSE = +inf). Handle these endpoints before an `inf - inf` exponent.
+Detector: `test_frost_sdpa_bias_sm120.py` checks negative/tiny/large scales,
+finite `±3e38` bias, all-`-inf` rows and sink endpoints through graph and
+standalone execution and changed-input replay.
+
+
 ## 2x2 datapath (cta_group::2, M=128 collective = 64 rows per CTA) lessons
 
 Kernels on this atom: forward `fwd/kernels/sm100/prefill_d512_f16_2x2.py` + `fwd/kernels/sm107/prefill_d512_f16_2x2.py`

+def _check(bufs, storage, mask, scale=None, stats_log2=False):
+    q, k, v = (bufs[n].double() for n in ("q", "k", "v"))
+    scores = (q @ k.repeat_interleave(2, 1).transpose(-1, -2)) * (q.shape[-1] ** -0.5 if scale is None else scale) + bufs["bias"].double()
+    qr = torch.arange(q.shape[-2], device="cuda")[:, None]
+    kr = torch.arange(k.shape[-2], device="cuda")[None, :]
+    if mask in ("causal", "window", "bottom_right", "band"):
+        offset = k.shape[-2] - q.shape[-2] if mask == "bottom_right" else 0
+        scores.masked_fill_(kr > qr + offset + (7 if mask == "band" else 0), -float("inf"))
+    if mask == "padded":
+        for batch in range(q.shape[0]):
+            scores[batch, :, int(bufs["seq_q"].flatten()[batch]) :] = -float("inf")
+            scores[batch, :, :, int(bufs["seq_kv"].flatten()[batch]) :] = -float("inf")
+    if mask == "window":
+        scores.masked_fill_(kr < qr - 24, -float("inf"))
+    logits = scores
